title: langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite==3.1.2
summary: Changes since checkpointsqlite==3.1.1 release(checkpoint-sqlite): 3.1.2 ( #9288 ) fix(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): treat an empty checkpoint_id as the latest in delta history ( #9262 ) fix(checkpoint,checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): validate namespace labels before store dispatch ( #9217 ) fix: order delta channel replay by task path ( #8544 ) chore(deps-dev): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs
body:
Changes since checkpointsqlite==3.1.1

- release(checkpoint-sqlite): 3.1.2 ( #9288 )

- fix(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): treat an empty checkpoint_id as the latest in delta history ( #9262 )

- fix(checkpoint,checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): validate namespace labels before store dispatch ( #9217 )

- fix: order delta channel replay by task path ( #8544 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-sqlite with 3 updates ( #9146 )

- chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /libs/checkpoint-sqlite ( #9135 )

- fix(checkpoint-sqlite): walk delta ancestors by parent pointer ( #8557 )

- chore(deps): bump anyio from 4.12.1 to 4.14.2 in /libs/checkpoint-sqlite ( #8993 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-sqlite with 2 updates ( #8772 )

- fix(checkpoint): widen Store put value type to Mapping[str, Any] ( #8617 )

- release(checkpoint): 4.2.0 ( #8563 )

- test(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): run the conformance suite ( #8537 )

- chore: enable RUF100 and clear unused noqa directives ( #8546 )

- chore(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): enable PLC0415 lint rule ( #8540 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-sqlite with 4 updates ( #8494 )
summaryZh: LangGraph推出了SQLite状态检查点组件的3.1.2版本。该版本修复了按任务路径对增量通道回放排序的问题，并补齐了分发前的命名空间校验与依赖项升级。适合在单机环境与本地测试中构建可靠的Agent记忆状态系统。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph SQLite持久化检查点组件的小版本维护，修复了通道回放与状态分发校验。
